heroHeadline: FDA Approves Durvalumab Plus Enfortumab Vedotin for Muscle-Invasive Bladder Cancer and Pimicotinib for TGCT in Week of New Oncology Approvals
heroSubtitle: On November 13, 2026, the FDA approved durvalumab with enfortumab vedotin-ejfv for muscle-invasive bladder cancer. On November 10, it approved pimicotinib (Pimjetmi) for symptomatic tenosynovial giant cell tumor, following the November 5 accelerated approval of subcutaneous amivantamab for head and neck cancer.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA Drug Approvals, NIH/NCI, peer-reviewed journals (NEJM, The Lancet, JCO, Nature, Nature Medicine), ASCO/ESMO/AACR conference data, and institutional analyses. All clinical data reflect published and presented trial results.
